The final reference-preserving candidate completes in253.706s including loading, slicing and export, with all4174470 ordered printer commands, motion role/width/height/Z annotations and1128 layers identical to the supplied G-code. Main work savings come from state-local radius reuse, point-buffer transfer with geometric handle growth, one-job TBB scheduling under existing RAM budgets, and a reviewed-engine-hash-gated no-intersection Clipper scanbeam shortcut. No quality/material/profile settings or fixed multi-GB cache were added. These timings and output identities are specific to the bound source, project and host and require fresh verification after changes.
